bug_description.original: Crash Type: Use-of-uninitialized-value; Crash State: LoadTGA / TGAHandler::read / kimgio_fuzzer.cc; Sanitizer: memory (MSAN)
bug_description.normalized: In LoadTGA, when decoding RLE-compressed TGA pixel data, a stack-allocated buffer char pixel[8] is declared without initialization. The call s.readRawData(pixel, pixel_size) may return fewer bytes than pixel_size when the input stream is exhausted, but the return value is not checked and no zero-fill of unread bytes is performed. The partially uninitialized pixel buffer is then memcpy'd into the image buffer and later read as a palette index in the pixel conversion phase, causing MSAN to detect a use-of-uninitialized-value.

source.description: Attacker-controlled TGA header field pixel_size is materialized into the local variable that determines how many bytes are read per RLE pixel from the stream.
source.value_from: Fuzz input parsed as TGA header by TGAHandler::read; tga.pixel_size is an 8-bit field from the header at offset 16.
source.note: For the PoC, tga.pixel_size is 8, so pixel_size = 1. This value controls the readRawData length and the memcpy size for the pixel buffer.

sink.code: scanline[x] = qRgb(palette[3 * idx + 2], palette[3 * idx + 1], palette[3 * idx + 0]);
sink.description: Uninitialized idx value (propagated from the pixel buffer through the image buffer) is used in arithmetic 3 * idx and as an array index into palette, triggering MSAN use-of-uninitialized-value.
sink.note: MSAN detects the uninitialized value at the first computation involving idx (3 * idx + 2). The uninitialized byte originated from the pixel stack buffer, was memcpy'd to the image heap buffer, and was loaded as idx = *src++.

root_cause.description: Stack buffer declared without initialization. When the subsequent readRawData call reads fewer than pixel_size bytes due to stream exhaustion, the unread bytes remain indeterminate. The missing return value check on readRawData allows these uninitialized bytes to propagate.
root_cause.note: The fix adds: const int dataRead = s.readRawData(pixel, pixel_size); if (dataRead < (int)pixel_size) { memset(&pixel[dataRead], 0, pixel_size - dataRead); } — ensuring all pixel_size bytes in pixel are defined before memcpy.

tainted_value_origin.note: Fuzz input is provided as raw bytes via QIODevice (backed by QBuffer in the fuzzer harness). The QDataStream wraps this device and carries all attacker-controlled TGA file data including header fields and pixel data.

coarse_trace.summary: Reads TGA header from attacker-controlled stream, validates the format via IsSupported (checks image_type, colormap fields, dimensions, pixel_size), seeks past the ID field, and passes the parsed header and stream to LoadTGA.

Derives pixel_size from header, enters the RLE decoding loop, allocates an uninitialized 8-byte stack buffer for RLE pixel data, reads fewer bytes than expected from the exhausted stream without checking the return value, memcpy's the partially uninitialized buffer into the image, then reads the uninitialized byte as a palette index in the pixel conversion phase.

fine_trace.note: Materializes attacker-controlled tga.pixel_size (from the TGA header) into the local pixel_size. For the PoC, tga.pixel_size = 8, so pixel_size = 1. This value controls the readRawData length and memcpy size for the RLE pixel buffer.
8-byte stack buffer allocated without initialization inside the RLE decoding loop body (c & 0x80 branch). All bytes are indeterminate until explicitly written by readRawData.

Reads pixel_size bytes from the attacker-controlled stream into the uninitialized pixel buffer. For the PoC, the stream is exhausted at this point (the last RLE packet header 0x9D consumed the final byte), so readRawData returns 0. The return value is discarded — no check guards against a partial or empty read, and no memset fills unread bytes. pixel[0] remains uninitialized.

Copies pixel_size bytes from the uninitialized pixel buffer to the image heap buffer pointed to by dst. The do-while loop repeats this copy count times (30 for the PoC, from RLE packet header 0x9D: count = (0x9D & 0x7f) + 1 = 30). All 30 destination bytes receive the uninitialized value.

Reads one byte from the image buffer (src points into the heap-allocated image). For pixels beyond the 4 initialized bytes, this loads an uninitialized value that was propagated from the pixel stack buffer via memcpy.

fine_trace.code: scanline[x] = qRgb(palette[3 * idx + 2], palette[3 * idx + 1], palette[3 * idx + 0]);
fine_trace.note: Uses the uninitialized idx in arithmetic (3 * idx + 2) and as an array index into palette to construct an RGB pixel. MSAN detects the use-of-uninitialized-value at this expression (line 301 column 36).

poc.trigger: The 26-byte PoC encodes a malformed TGA file with image_type=9 (RLE indexed), pixel_size=8, id_length=32, width=1, height=34, colormap_length=0. The oversized id_length causes the seek to position 50 to fail (file is only 26 bytes), leaving the stream at position 18. The remaining 8 bytes are consumed as RLE packets; the final byte 0x9D has the high bit set (RLE mode) with count=30. At this point the stream is exhausted, so readRawData(pixel, 1) returns 0, leaving pixel[0] uninitialized. The uninitialized byte is memcpy'd 30 times into the image buffer and later used as a palette index in qRgb.

format.name: TGA
format.contract: A truncated 26-byte TGA file where id_length (32) exceeds the remaining file length, causing the id-skip seek to fail and leaving the stream positioned at the raw bytes after the header. The last byte must have the RLE flag (bit 7 set) so that the code enters the RLE pixel path, and the stream must be exhausted before the pixel readRawData call so that the pixel buffer is not filled.
